notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Reduced the time of displaying the loading screen after the death of an agent. It was really too long.
[*]One very important notification has been added, without which you can get lost in time in real life. We don't want that. If I tell you what the notification is, I'll spoiler the puzzle walkthrough.
[*]A couple of small fixes in the code. 
[*]Ah yes, new pictures for logo.
[/list]

notes.title: ⭐ First week! Thank you!
notes.content:
It's already been a week since the release of Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles! 🎉

We are incredibly happy to see that the game is bringing you joy and fun!

🙏 A huge thank you to everyone who played the game, and an even bigger thanks to those who left a review — it really helps the game's visibility with Steam's algorithms! ⭐

🐞 Fortunately, no bugs have been found so far, but there have still been a few updates this week:

[list]
[*] The level select menu now shows where you've found secrets.
[*] Some levels have been slightly adjusted to improve their design and flow.
[*] A few small visual changes have been made.
[/list]

👀 Be sure to keep following the project — there will be both major and minor updates, with new levels and secrets on the way! 🚀
